photos.c: Michael Manning (64), who has become one of our leading Youths this winter, and David Bailey (50), another promising youngster, warm up for the Boxing Day 2 miles handicap.
Front Page: David Bailey strides out to win the Senior Boys 100m at the Club Championships and shows fine style in the process. Ivan Beaumont was second and Mark Shippen third.
Right: Junior David Bailey had good cause to smile after collecting his haul of trophies at the end of the meeting.
